conditions.text: LLM Agent가 도구의 이름과 설명을 읽고, 사용할 도구를 스스로 선택하는가? 아니면, 특정 프롬프트에 대해서는 사용할 도구가 정해져있는가?
conditions.native_evidence_limit: Native input, rendered prompt, tool-choice mode and generated tool-call output establish the observed selection path. A generated call is not proof of actual dispatch.

conditions.native_evidence_limit: Tool JSON syntax validation and chat-template rendering are not metadata security review. Whether a review exists must be observed in the agent policy path. T means a review exists, not that AMA is blocked.

conditions.text: LLM Agent가 최종적으로 선택한 도구의 메타데이터를, 기록할 수 있는가?
conditions.native_evidence_limit: Join received metadata with the native selected function name using the same request_id; the agent must resolve tool names uniquely and log the exact selected metadata.

conditions.text: LLM Agent가 선택한 도구의 실제 호출 여부와, 호출 시 도구에 전달한 매개변수를 기록할 수 있는가?
conditions.native_evidence_limit: Native response contains a generated call proposal. Public HTTP client request/response evidence or an explicit pre-send rejection is required to record actual invocation status; post-send uncertainty remains raw null.

interpretation_limits: This source mapping is bound to the exact completed sealed run in source_run; it is not itself an attack-success report.
AC1 requires both the selected API's verified public platform provenance and confirmed external HTTPS invocation; the three native points alone cannot establish either condition.
AC2 means the native inference engine itself changed or withheld the tool metadata before rendering it; tool JSON parsing or native grammar enforcement is not that review.
The fixed-tool control provides only the designated normal tool with tool_choice=required; it is not unrestricted automatic choice.
DC1/DC2 describe acquired evidence, not attack-detection accuracy. Provider-internal execution or data retention is not instrumented.
Only nonstreaming n=1 requests are included. The shared public fixture is reused across engines, not newly held-out for each engine.
The Q4_K_M model, native chat template and tool grammar differ from SGLang/vLLM FP32; observed differences cannot be attributed solely to inference-engine choice.
Postman is a benign public test API. Tool names/descriptions and the private meaning of foo2 are local experimental overlays, not a malicious platform-published tool.

supporting_sources.finding: Tool type and function fields are parsed and validated structurally. This is not an AMA metadata-security decision.
Generated text is parsed by common_chat_parse into assistant messages and tool calls. This does not dispatch a tool.
The native parser output is serialized as choices[].message.tool_calls before LP03 observes the response.

observed_status: 실제 완료된 원시 실행에 연결됨. source_run 및 지점별 관측 수를 확인하십시오.

operational_boundaries.judgment: Each T/F/null answers its own workbook question, never AND(all AC) => attack success. AC2 (workbook AC3 before the 2026-09-12 revision) = true means the native inference engine itself performed a metadata security review.
operational_boundaries.aggregation: Every selected request is evaluated independently; overall condition T requires all selected request judgments T. No-call requests are retained, and missing required events remain null.
operational_boundaries.scope: Versioned public-API experiment: selected API provenance plus confirmed external HTTPS invocation, with local metadata overlays explicitly distinguished from original public catalog metadata. No claim of an attacker-owned provider or full-paper QNT reproduction.
operational_boundaries.observation_boundary: Native inference observes metadata intake, prompt rendering and generated calls. The agent verifies selected-tool public catalog lineage and actual HTTPS exchange. A provider response is not provider-side source instrumentation.
operational_boundaries.coverage_fields: all_selected_platform_origins_verified and all_selected_public_calls_confirmed are independently recomputed after selection/dispatch from actual selected-tool source bindings and captured HTTP evidence; they are not static registry labels. No-call requests remain false; unknown confirmation remains null. execution_recorded describes evidence completeness, not attack success.
operational_boundaries.protocol_change_note: The workbook wording is preserved exactly as revised on 2026-09-12, when the tool-platform-origin condition was removed because an OpenAI-compatible tools array carries no endpoint, platform or provenance field into the inference engine. Public-platform origin and confirmed external invocation are still recorded as agent-layer evidence, but no longer decide a workbook condition.

freeze.claim_limit: Source mapping binds recorded evidence; it does not independently recompute attack outcomes or replace protocol verification.
